name: radio-browser
description: radio-browser.info is a free, community-maintained directory of about 62,000 internet radio stations. This CLI searches stations, shows station details, check results, clicks and edit history, lists countries, tags, languages and codecs, reads global stats, and can get a stream URL (which counts a click) or vote for a station.

commands.name: search-stations
commands.summary: Search radio stations by name, tag, country code, language or codec, with sorting and offset pagination

params.name: name
params.description: Substring match on the station name

params.name: tagList
params.description: Comma-separated tags. A station must have all of them, e.g. 'jazz' or 'jazz,smooth jazz'

params.name: countrycode
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. FR, US, DE

params.name: language
params.description: Language name in lowercase English, e.g. german, english

params.name: codec
params.description: Stream codec, e.g. MP3, AAC, AAC+, OGG

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field

params.name: reverse
params.description: 'true' sorts descending, 'false' ascending

params.name: hidebroken
params.description: 'true' leaves out stations whose last check failed

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-station
commands.summary: Get full details of one station by its stationuuid

params.name: uuid
params.description: Station UUID (stationuuid from search-stations)

commands.name: get-station-checks
commands.summary: List recent stream health checks for a station (ok flag, codec, bitrate, timing, metadata)

params.name: uuid
params.description: Station UUID

commands.name: get-check-steps
commands.summary: Get the individual check steps (URLs tried, URL type, errors) for one or more stations

params.name: uuids
params.description: Comma-separated station UUIDs

commands.name: get-station-clicks
commands.summary: List click (play) events for a station within a recent time window

params.name: uuid
params.description: Station UUID

params.name: seconds
params.description: Look-back window in seconds (86400 = last 24h)

commands.name: get-station-history
commands.summary: Get the edit history (all recorded versions) of a station

params.name: uuid
params.description: Station UUID

commands.name: list-countries
commands.summary: List country codes with station counts, optionally filtered by a substring

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional substring of the country code, e.g. 'DE'. Empty lists all

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field

params.name: reverse
params.description: true sorts descending

params.name: hidebroken
params.description: Leave broken stations out of the counts

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum entries returned (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List station tags with station counts. Pass a filter for tag suggestions matching a substring

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional substring to match tag names, e.g. 'rock'. Empty lists all

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field

params.name: reverse
params.description: true sorts descending

params.name: hidebroken
params.description: Leave broken stations out of the counts

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum entries returned (the tags page uses 1000, suggestions use 5) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: list-languages
commands.summary: List languages (with ISO 639 code) and station counts, optionally filtered by a substring

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional substring of the language name, e.g. 'germ'. Empty lists all

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field

params.name: reverse
params.description: true sorts descending

params.name: hidebroken
params.description: Leave broken stations out of the counts

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum entries returned (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: list-codecs
commands.summary: List stream codecs (MP3, AAC+, OGG, …) with station counts, optionally filtered by a substring

params.name: filter
params.description: Optional substring of the codec name, e.g. 'AAC'. Empty lists all

params.name: order
params.description: Sort field

params.name: reverse
params.description: true sorts descending

params.name: hidebroken
params.description: Leave broken stations out of the counts

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum entries returned (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-stats
commands.summary: Get global directory stats: station, broken-station, tag, language and country counts, plus recent clicks

commands.name: play-station
commands.summary: Get a station's playable stream URL. This registers one click (play) for the station on radio-browser

params.name: uuid
params.description: Station UUID

notes: All data comes from the public, no-login JSON API at de1.api.radio-browser.info. Other mirrors work the same way (see api.radio-browser.info).

play-station and vote-station are plain GET requests, but they have side effects. play-station counts a click and vote-station adds a public vote. Do not call either one just to read data. Use get-station to see url/url_resolved without counting a click.
During exploration, two unintended votes were sent: one on the jazz search page and one for France Info (1cfb151d-a341-11e9-a787-52543be04c81). The API has no way to undo a vote.
Station search booleans (hidebroken, reverse) are sent as the strings 'true'/'false', exactly as the web app sends them.
The stationuuid returned by search-stations is the uuid that get-station, get-station-checks, get-station-clicks, get-station-history, get-check-steps, play-station and vote-station take.
The list-* commands use the empty path filter by default, which lists everything. Pass --filter for type-ahead suggestions, as the search box does with limit=5.

The site also offers exports of the same station search at /{csv|xml|json|m3u|pls|xspf|ttl}/stations/search on the API host. These were not recorded as separate requests, so no command was made for them.
The geo map request returned an empty body and the add-station form was never submitted, so neither has a command. /json/config is app config and was skipped.
